    AI Overview
    Use this structured text template to quickly build your portfolio submission form. You can copy and paste these fields into your preferred online form builder (such as Jotform or Google Forms) to easily collect creative work, writing samples, or application materials. 
    Section 1: Contact Information
    • Full Name: [Text Input]
    • Email Address: [Email Input]
    • Phone Number: [Tel Input]
    • Current Title / Institution: [Text Input] 
    Section 2: Portfolio Details
    • Portfolio Type: [Dropdown: Creative/Design, Writing, Photography, Coding/Tech, Other]
    • Portfolio Link (URL): [URL Input]
    • Upload Portfolio (PDFs or Images): [File Upload - Max 25MB] 
    Section 3: Project Breakdown
    • Project Title(s): [Text Input]
    • Brief Description / Artist Statement: [Text Area - 250 word limit]
    • Key Tools / Skills Used: [Checkboxes: Adobe Suite, Figma, Python, HTML/CSS, Other] 
    Section 4: Declaration & Review
    • How did you hear about this opportunity? [Dropdown: Social Media, Referral, Job Board, Website]
    • Originality Confirmation: [Checkbox: I confirm that all work submitted is my own original creation.] 
    If you would like, tell me:
    • What industry this portfolio is for
    • If you need to collect application fees or specific file types
    I can tailor the exact fields to fit your specific use case.
